``quantity``/``filled_quantity`` are ``None`` when the source row did not
yield a parsable number. ``None`` means "unknown" and must not be filled
with 0 or a previous value: 0 is a real filled quantity, so conflating the
two turns an unreadable row into "nothing was filled".

EvidenceFact.description:
Deterministic, source-backed fact with provenance (CG-006).

``statement`` is assembled verbatim from the collected evidence row —
numbers are never recomputed or reformatted, so a fact is exactly as
trustworthy as the source row it came from. Every fact gets a stable
id (``F1``, ``F2``, ...) so model prose can cite ``[F12]`` and the
citation can be checked against the deterministic packet.

FxProposalSpec.description:

``action`` is a fixed literal: this surface cannot express an execution
instruction. ``rationale_tokens`` separates sourced facts from derived /
AI-authored reasoning via the ``sourced:`` / ``inference:`` prefixes so a
consumer never has to guess which is which. ``strength`` is optional and
stays ``None`` when there is no basis for it (fail-closed).

IrMonitorOutcome.description:
Full outcome for one monitoring run over one IR source.

``fetch_state`` is derived from what the run actually retrieved, not from
the listing GET alone: a run that discovered documents but could not
retrieve a single byte is ``FAILED``. Counts are split so a caller reading
only the summary cannot confuse "new documents detected on the listing
page" with "new document bytes retrieved": ``new_count`` counts URL-level
new detections (including documents beyond the fetch budget), while
``fetched_count`` counts records whose content was actually retrieved this
run.
IrMonitorOutcome.title: IrMonitorOutcome

ScreeningCandidate.description:
One machine-discovered observation candidate.

``code`` follows the repo-wide JPX local code grammar: a bare 4-digit
weekly-source spelling or (for EDINET issuers) the 5-digit security code
EDINET publishes; value decoration is never repaired. ``value`` holds the
concrete numbers that triggered the signal — absent numbers are omitted,
never replaced with zeros. ``document_id`` is the per-document evidence
key when the candidate comes from one filing (EDINET ``docID``); sources
without a document leave it ``None`` — two different documents for the
same issuer/signal are two candidates, the same document is one fact
(audit Y03).
ScreeningCandidate.title: ScreeningCandidate

upstream failures are 502. No order is created or sent.
